mapper.insert: INSERT INTO projects (title, status, client_name, commercial_flow, summary, process, start_date, end_date, skill, headcount, remaining_count, bp_recruitment, bp_recruitment_detail, work_location, estimated_unit_price, contract_type, note, created_by, created_department, created_at, updated_by, updated_department, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{status}, #{clientName}, #{commercialFlow}, #{summary}, #{process}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{skill}, #{headcount}, #{remainingCount}, #{bpRecruitment}, #{bpRecruitmentDetail}, #{workLocation}, #{estimatedUnitPrice}, #{contractType}, #{note}, #{createdBy}, #{createdDepartment}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedDepartment}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE projects SET title = #{project.title}, status = #{project.status}, client_name = #{project.clientName}, commercial_flow = #{project.commercialFlow}, summary = #{project.summary}, process = #{project.process}, start_date = #{project.startDate}, end_date = #{project.endDate}, skill = #{project.skill}, headcount = #{project.headcount}, remaining_count = #{project.remainingCount}, bp_recruitment = #{project.bpRecruitment}, bp_recruitment_detail = #{project.bpRecruitmentDetail}, work_location = #{project.workLocation}, estimated_unit_price = #{project.estimatedUnitPrice}, contract_type = #{project.contractType}, note = #{project.note}, updated_by = #{project.updatedBy}, updated_department = #{project.updatedDepartment}, updated_at = #{project.updatedAt} WHERE management_code = #{project.managementCode} AND updated_at = #{loadedUpdatedAt}
